card.name: Inside ergot drug names
card.fires_on: The piece 'ot' in 'ergot' when it is split from the rest of the word, as in dihydroergotamine, ergotamine and ergot alkaloids. Also once on 'Her' inside Herceptin.

modes.label: Herceptin
modes.description: The 'Her' piece at the start of the brand name Herceptin after paclitaxel.
